title: Pass by Reference
learning_objective: Use a non-const lvalue reference parameter so a function modifies the caller's object.
instructions: Fix setToTwenty so it modifies the original integer. Submit only the function; do not add main().
hints: Passing by value modifies only a copy.
The parameter must alias the caller's integer.
explanation: A non-const lvalue reference parameter aliases the caller's object. Clang AST analysis verifies the parameter type.
